הטיפול הפיזיותרפי ברצפת האגן- כל מה שצרי: Pelvic floor physiotherapy - everything you need to know about pelvic floor muscle rehabilitation
השרירים ברצפת האגן הם שרירים רצוניים ברו: The pelvic floor muscles are mostly voluntary muscles, which means we can control their contraction and relaxation, and we can strengthen them (just as we strengthen muscles at the gym). But the common difficulty is recognizing their action and isolating it from the action of other nearby muscles, and learning to use them with the right timing together with the other postural muscles – bladder and bowel control.
הזכרנו \"שרירים\", אך משהו בכל זאת מייחד: We said "muscles", yet something does set these muscles apart from the other muscles in our body – their location. This is also what makes physiotherapy in this area so special: working with muscles in such an intimate place can bring up many feelings, such as apprehension, discomfort, shame, embarrassment, aversion… This is why pelvic floor physiotherapy is conducted a little differently from "routine" physiotherapy.
הטיפול הפיזיותרפי ברצפת האגן נפתח, קודם: Pelvic floor physiotherapy opens, first of all, with guidance and information about the area and its functions. Then comes an interview, in which the patient is asked about the symptoms they are experiencing. If problems come up, they are addressed right away with guidance and practical advice. The muscle examination is done only at the final stage (sometimes not even at the first session), and it is done together with the patient, in a spirit of sharing, learning and guidance.
במהלך הטיפול י/תלמד המטופל/ת לזהות את שר: During treatment the patient learns to identify the pelvic floor muscles and to use them. Treatment sometimes also makes use of biofeedback. The biofeedback device passes information from an electrode that transmits data from the muscles to a computer screen, letting the patient and the treating physiotherapist see how the patient is using the pelvic floor muscles: to assess the quality of the muscles' contraction and relaxation, and their endurance. Thanks to the biofeedback device the patient can learn to use the muscles more correctly and also follow their own progress.
הטיפול השיקומי ברצפת האגן כולל טכניקות ט: Pelvic floor rehabilitation includes manual treatment techniques, external and internal, for treating muscles, connective tissue and nerves.
אורך הטיפול משתנה והוא תלוי בכמה זמן נמש: The length of treatment varies. It depends on how long the symptoms have lasted, what treatments have been given for them so far, and on your cooperation with the home exercises you will need to do.
טיפול הפיזיותרפיה לשיקום רצפת האגן כולל: Physiotherapy for pelvic floor rehabilitation includes help with and treatment of the following problems: pelvic pain, rectal pain, chronic pelvic floor pain (Chronic Pelvic Pain Syndrome), dyspareunia (pain during intercourse), bladder pain, pelvic organ prolapse, urinary incontinence, fecal / gas incontinence, urinary or fecal frequency and urgency, and constipation.

המדריך השלם לרצפת האגן וחשיבות שרירי רצפ: The complete guide to the pelvic floor and why the pelvic floor muscles matter in our lives
המונח רצפת האגן מתייחס לאזור הנמצא בתחתי: The term pelvic floor refers to the area at the bottom of the pelvis: the area we sit on, the one we all pass through on the day we are born, and the one our bodily waste passes through all our lives.
מה תפקידה של רצפת האגן בחיינו?: What does the pelvic floor do in our lives?
על רצפת האגן מונחים כל איברי האגן והבטן: All our pelvic and abdominal organs rest on the pelvic floor. It lets us "hold on" and control our bladder and bowels, and it is part of our postural muscle system, so together with the abdominal and back muscles it protects the spine (hence the link to back pain). The pelvic floor is also directly linked to our sexual function (erection and orgasm) and to the process of giving birth.
ממה עשויה רצפת האגן?: What is the pelvic floor made of?
רצפת האגן היא ערסלית בצורתה (למרות השם \: The pelvic floor is shaped like a hammock (despite the name "floor"), and it is made of soft tissue only – muscles, connective tissue and, of course, the blood vessels and nerves that supply the whole area. Most of the pelvic floor muscles are voluntary, which means we can control their contraction and relaxation, and we can strengthen them (just as we strengthen any other muscle at the gym). Some of these muscles are there to "close" (for example, closing the openings so that nothing escapes), and some are there to "lift and open" (for example, when emptying).
איברי האגן (זכר): שלפוחית השתן, ערמונית: The pelvic organs (male): bladder, prostate, rectum, pubic bone and pelvic floor muscles
איברי האגן (נקבה): רחם, שחלה, שלפוחית הש: The pelvic organs (female): uterus, ovary, bladder, vagina, rectum, pubic bone and pelvic floor muscles
מה חשיבותם של שרירי רצפת האגן?: Why do the pelvic floor muscles matter?
בהיותם בסיס תומך לאיברי האגן, חוזק שרירי: As the supporting base of the pelvic organs, the strength of these muscles affects the normal position of the pelvic organs: the bladder, the uterus, the bowel and the rectum. In daily life, weakness and slackness of these muscles cause varying degrees of loss of bladder and bowel control, urinary incontinence, leakage of stool or gas, hemorrhoids, and prolapse of the bladder, uterus, bowel or rectum. Another kind of pelvic floor dysfunction is over-contraction of some of its muscles (sometimes compensating for weakness in another part), which shows up as difficulty emptying (urine or stool) or as pain during intercourse. Pelvic floor physiotherapy makes it possible to strengthen the pelvic floor muscles and so to prevent these problems.

איך בכל זאת מומלץ לתרגל באופן עצמאי?: So how is it best to practice on your own?
כאשר שרירי רצפת האגן מתכווצים, התחושה דו: When the pelvic floor muscles contract, it feels like "closing" the openings (the urethra, the vaginal opening and the anus), together with a feeling of "lifting" the openings away from the surface we are sitting on.
שרירי רצפת האגן אינם חשופים לעין, אך יש: The pelvic floor muscles cannot be seen, but there are several ways to identify their action:
התבוננות במראה קטנה כדי לראות את \"התכנס: Looking in a small mirror to see the perineum (the area between the vaginal opening and the anus) "draw in" when the pelvic floor muscles contract.
\"מבחן עצירת השתן\" (אני מדגישה כי זהו ר: The "stop test" (I stress that this is only a test, and it must not be used as a regular way of exercising the pelvic floor muscles, because contracting while urinating as a routine exercise can harm the bladder): while urinating, try to stop the flow at its strongest for 2-3 seconds. Then finish urinating, but remember the action.
רצפת האגן היא חלק משרירי הנשימה והיציבה: The pelvic floor is part of our breathing and postural muscles, and as such it always works in coordination with the breath and with the abdominal muscles. In my view, exercise that deals only with pelvic floor contractions and ignores the importance of the abdominal muscles and the breath is incomplete, and does not give a proper, full solution to most pelvic floor problems.
בנוסף, כאשר סובלים ממתח יתר ברצפת האגן (: In addition, when there is excess tension in the pelvic floor (for example pain, or difficulty emptying), "squeezing" exercises can even make the problem worse.
לכן, הדרך הנכונה והטובה ביותר היא להיבדק: So the right and best way is to be examined by a professional, get a thorough assessment of the state of your pelvic floor and abdominal muscles, and make sure the exercises are tailored personally to you.
אם בכל זאת תבחרו \"לנסות בעצמכם\", הדרך: If you still choose to "try it yourself", the way to make sure the pelvic floor is recruited more correctly is to start the action with an exhale (= breathing out), without first taking in more air, while lowering the rib cage (narrowing it), and then to "accompany" the exhale with a contraction of the pelvic floor muscles.
דרך נוספת לתרגול, בנוסף על השיטה הראשונה: Another way to practice, in addition to the first method (and not instead of it), is to try a quick exhale (as in a cough, for example) and then accompany the cough or the quick exhale with a contraction of the pelvic floor muscles. This exercise trains the muscle to respond quickly, because besides the muscle's general strength, we want it to be skilled enough to engage quickly "to protect us.
למעשה אפשר (ואפילו צריך) ללוות את הפעולו: In fact we can (and even should) accompany our everyday actions (especially those that involve effort) with an exhale together with a pelvic floor contraction – this way we give better protection to our spine and to our abdominal and pelvic organs.
טיפים ששוים זהב לבריאות רצפת האגן- מניעת: Golden tips for pelvic floor health - preventing constipation, pain and urinary leakage
לפניך מספר טיפים ששווים זהב. הקפידו לייש: Here are a few tips that are worth their weight in gold. Make a point of following them and you will help improve your condition
בכמות שתיה ממוצעת של כ- 2 ליטר ליממה מספ: With an average fluid intake of about 2 liters a day, you should urinate about 7 times during the day and at most once more at night. Drinks containing caffeine or white alcohol (such as coffee, tea, cola, chocolate milk, beer and so on) increase the need to urinate, so it is best not to have more than two cups of them. This will help reduce urinary leakage.
התאפקות בהחלט רצויה– אך במידה: שלפוחית ש: Holding on is definitely a good thing – but in moderation: a healthy bladder should allow 2.5 to 4 hours of "quiet" without needing to empty
הטלת צואה 3 פעמים ביום או בשבוע נחשבת לנ: Passing stool 3 times a day or 3 times a week is considered normal if it involves no pain or straining and you finish with a feeling of complete emptying. If you have difficulty emptying or problems with control – it may be a functional pelvic floor problem, which can be helped with pelvic floor physiotherapy techniques
תזונה נכונה, שתיה נאותה ופעילות גופנית מ: A good diet, enough fluids and physical activity encourage healthy, correct emptying habits
הקדימ/י כיווץ לכל פעולה מאמצת: לפני הרמה: Contract before every effort: before lifting, pushing, changing position, shouting, coughing or sneezing – contract the pelvic floor and the transverse abdominal muscle first, while lengthening the torso and breathing out. This will strengthen your pelvic floor muscles.
בזמן הטלת שתן או צואה הרפה/י והימנע/י מל: When passing urine or stool, relax and avoid straining. This will reduce problems of involuntary urinary leakage and fecal leakage.
